normalization.unit: String caps are UTF-16 code units unless explicitly bytes. Legacy helper removes NUL, trims, truncates; wrong-typed scalar uses fallback, string lists omit wrong-typed/empty entries. New strict admission versus legacy truncation must be declared, never hidden loss.

word.table: requires nonempty headers; each retained row padded/truncated to header width; wrong-type rows skipped

excel.sheetName: 31-unit sanitized name; case-insensitive dedup suffix; unnamed fallback SheetN
excel.rowWidth: max(headers.length,1); extra cells lost under legacy normalizer
excel.formulas: Legacy rows are strings. This DTO does not establish R2 editable formula/recalculation/reference-total correctness.

powerpoint.notesBound: MAX_TEXT_BYTES used by scalar string helper, hence UTF-16 cap here rather than encoded byte proof

text.exactBytes: No text trim, newline or BOM loss; reject lone-surrogate replacement, invalid UTF8 and C0/DEL controls except TAB/LF/CR; 1..1048576 UTF8 bytes

normalization.images: UUID-shaped references and inline base64 are separate legacy inputs; generation resolves current tenant/user/conversation/client context and rejects combined count>4 or oversize retained chart. Base64 string admission alone is not image validation.

artifactVariants: raw created ClioArtifact scalar row with metadata JSON
{persisted:false,reason} when no conversation; native non-text generation may return no persisted row
creationResult.downloads: DOCX/PDF conversion entries on saved Word/PDF; an advertised link is not completed rendering
creationResult.notNewWire: Raw Prisma row and base64 metadata are not recommended new Meri wire representation.

clioArtifactScalars.metadata: stored JSON; source creation writes generated bytes/digest/size/native format/byte authority plus optional text operation receipt

currentChecks: current client security envelope for associated client
exact selected native format or DOCX/PDF-only conversion
canonical base64, declared size and SHA256
text current proposal/effect receipt when present
delivery.truth: Structural native-byte checks and URLs do not prove rendered visual fidelity. R2 native open, renderer isolation, reference/formula totals and revision comparison remain separate.

proposedPrivateContracts.name: ArtifactGenerationInput
proposedPrivateContracts.scope: Three native creation operations plus explicit text/PDF variants; canonical inert admission, declared bounds and no silent loss; authorized immutable inputs as ObjectReferences; no model-supplied tenant/user/approval fields

proposedPrivateContracts.name: ArtifactValidationEvidence
proposedPrivateContracts.scope: Bind version/object SHA, input references, format, validator/renderer identity, measured checks and explicit failures/unsupported features. New Meri protocol, no claimed legacy DTO. Never model-minted proof.

proposedPrivateContracts.name: ArtifactFileArguments
proposedPrivateContracts.attachments: Command.attachments exact ObjectReferences,1..10; source attachment IDs retained by trusted adapter correlation, not assumed equal to objectId

proposedPrivateContracts.name: ArtifactFileResult
proposedPrivateContracts.shape: existing CommandReceipt plus per-object source filing observations; saved/pending/failed and indexing status separate; a quarantined persisted record is not readable or indexed success

qualification: All source adapters/generation/rendering/filing remain unavailable; no persisted bytes, image decoder, provider or renderer was run.
